description: AtmosphereTool 2.0.0: integrate continuous style-specific density along scene rays in an authored OpenGL client component, clipped to selected bounds, air clearance and scene depth; publish local occupancy atomically from a bounded server worker and update material parameters without rebuilding/uploading unchanged masks.
changes: Retain preview.2 material GLSL and one shared 32-cubed R16F noise texture initialized once.
Add saved per-area Transparency slider below Density, preserving density semantics and old zero-transparency defaults.
Keep the active lease and cached mask on material edits; coalesce edits at 500 ms and discard stale worker revisions. The full packet is still written, but unchanged masks are not uploaded to GPU.
Package JAR and Atmosphere_Tool_Client_Component with hash/build checks, recognized-version backups, rollback on failed install and explicit restore.
Remove obsolete particle assets from JAR; preserve server API dependencies and active UI/item resources.
advantages: User-approved continuous appearance without moving cubes or asset reloads
64 KiB shared GPU noise texture; no animation atlas
GPU budget adapts asynchronously; CPU terrain work yields
Installer and actual local update preserve saved data
disadvantages: Native client modification is unsupported by official mod loading; manual client installation required
Exact Windows client fingerprint; future game updates require validation
Dense combined grid limited to 16 areas and 4,194,304 cells; sparse distant selections can exceed limits
Extreme overlap and high resolution remain expensive even at minimum sample budget
Cached packet adds up to 16 MiB Java memory; maximum concurrent main arrays approximately 56 MiB
test_results: Java regression and Hytale native temporary-world lifecycle probe passed, including rapid transparency edits retaining lease and identical mask body.
Production JAR boots with one registration and shuts down on Hytale 0.7.2 / Java 25.
14-style appearance/animation comparisons, transparency checks, reduced-budget comparisons and 32 GPU timing cases passed on RTX 5060.
Six native post-shader variants compile; DLL integration reports zero GL errors and no new mask upload on transparency change.
Windows PowerShell 5 fixtures pass fresh/repeated/upgrade/restore, injected copy rollback and validation rejection scenarios.
ZIP inventory/CRC/payload hashes pass. Actual local installation checked four payload hashes and eight unchanged saved JSON files.
User approved preview.2 appearance; 2.0.0 shaders are identical. New slider presentation awaits ordinary in-game use.

metrics.execution_cost: JAR 197050 bytes versus 831096; complete ZIP 283183 bytes; noise 64 KiB GPU; mask up to 8 MiB GPU.
metrics.reliability: Atomic publication with epoch cancellation and lease lifecycle; transactional installation and validated rollback fixture.
metrics.performance: GPU samples 32-128, resolution cap, 1.4-2.4 ms timing hysteresis target (not guarantee); terrain pass target 2 ms or 32768 cells every 500 ms. No weaker GPU certification.
metrics.compatibility: Windows x64, exact tested Hytale 0.7.2 client, local singleplayer. Mod-browser complete install false.
